Sectoare de activitate: Tehnologie, informații și mass-media și Servicii de publicitate
About Eightpoint 
 Eightpoint is an internet technology company specializing in the agile development of products and content that address real-world interests, captivating users and driving significant growth for partners. With offices in the United States and Cayman Islands, Eightpoint collaborates with partners globally on the next generation of user-centric offerings. Our growing ecosystem includes innovative products like Weather Now, a sleek app that delivers real-time forecasts with clarity and ranks among the top three most-used weather apps in the U.S.; Check Heart Rate Now, a quick and easy wellness monitor; and Wave Browser, a powerful and secure way to search the web. Every product we launch is designed to engage users, enhance daily life, and deliver real-world value. Backed by data and driven by a relentless commitment to quality, Eightpoint moves fast, thinks big, and builds digital experiences that people love.
 Our innovative culture thrives on collaboration, data-driven decisions, and a startup mindset. Join our team and enjoy top-tier benefits, unlimited PTO, flexible schedules, free lunches, and the opportunity to work alongside a world-class team of professionals.
 About the Role 
 The Senior iOS Engineer will manage multiple iOS Applications. The position will be focused on building, maintaining, and improving multiple apps within our portfolio. In this role, you will be expected to take ownership by creating, testing, and deploying production-ready code and design. Here at Eightpoint, we are building apps and creating tools & experiences that users want. As an iOS engineer, you will have autonomy to modify and enhance the apps you build and maintain. 
 Where You’ll Make an Impact: 
Close collaboration with our User Acquisition, Design and Business Intelligence teams will occur daily
As an engineer at Spigot, you will participate in building back-end processes and optimizations, creating & collecting content for the apps & designing and deploying cutting-edge user experiences
User experience improvement – through in-app optimization and design enhancement.
Coding: Bringing applications to life using Swift with Swift UI mostly and small parts in UIKit
A/B Testing: Monitoring performance across multiple variations of a UX/UI to determine the top performer
Optimization: Iterate to increase KPIs in each point of the conversion funnel
Competitive Research: Proactively keeping up to date on industry trends
 Who You Are: 
5+ years’ development experience, with advanced knowledge of Swift, Swift UI, UI Kit, Combine
Experience with baseline analytics – able to perform A/B testing and select winning solutions
Knowledge of LLM Application Development, LLM Orchestration Frameworks, and Prompt Engineering within AI tools is a plus
Exposure with Flutter, Kotlin, Kotlin Multiplatform, or Android Development
